description: This file defines the GatewayDiscoverySelectionSupport enum with static methods to apply and determine remote gateway selection logic, including preferences for direct transport based on gateway properties.

methods.name: applyRemoteSelection
methods.description: Configures the remote gateway URL and transport preferences based on the discovered gateway and current application state.

methods.name: preferredTransport
methods.description: Determines whether to prefer a direct transport for the given gateway based on specific criteria.

methods.name: shouldPreferDirectTransport
methods.description: Checks if the gateway qualifies for direct transport preference based on its URL and hostname.
